description: Machine index of the 19 visual identities for 9:16 shorts (22 declinations: 3 of them are derivations of a root identity, see variantOf). Use it to shortlist identities, then read each identity's identity.md (16 sections, French) and tokens.json. coreTokens is a normalised subset (seconds, pixels on a 1080x1920 canvas, @fontsource slugs); the original tokens.json is authoritative for everything else. curation.* is orchestrator judgment. See AGENTS.md.

families.name: Papier découpé
families.axis: Même moteur papier-moteur, même pop stop-motion à 12 i/s, mêmes bandes de papier inclinées, mêmes sous-titres sur bande ; seuls changent le fond (tapis vert, tapis bleu nuit, kraft, bleu nuit uni), la palette et les polices.

fieldNotes.variantOf: id of the root identity when this entry is a derivation (same engine, only ground / palette / fonts change), else null. A root lists its derivations in variants and what is shared / what varies in variantAxis. Derivations stay ranked, right after their root; counts.identities counts roots only, counts.declinations counts every entry. curation.deliberateSiblings = derivations of the same root, deliberately close and therefore not listed in confusableWith. A new identity that reuses an existing engine and only changes ground / palette / fonts must be registered as a derivation, not as a new identity
fieldNotes.status: selected = kept in Phase 1; rehabilitated = set aside in Phase 1 only to avoid topic overlap with a neighbour, then produced on request with the same rules and evidence level; added = added after the campaign: (a) the cut-paper identity from the StudioGabarit template, papier-decoupe, and its 3 derivations (atelier-papier, carnet-archives, cabinet-curiosites), rendered by the shared Python engine out/shared/papier-moteur/, appended after the ranked identities and not part of the ranking or the blind visual judge; (b) lot 2 of the identity factory (trait-continu, carte-meteo, 2026-11-05: scouting + adversarial challenge + studio + review), ranked with the others, blind visual judge on 8 identities (lot 2 + 6 neighbours, 8/8 pure groups, out/report/notes/revue-2026-11-05.md), voice-over Gemini Sulafat like the cut-paper family (owner decision: Fish Audio credits ran out before Arnold could be recorded); (c) lyrics-punchy and lyrics-chemin (2026-11-19), the two identities of the new content family `paroles` (muted lyric video, no voice-over), unranked, appended last, one proof short each rendered with filler lyrics (real lyrics and audio stay outside the repository)
fieldNotes.voiceUsed: voice actually mixed into short.mp4 (Fish Audio Arnold for the 31 campaign shorts, Gemini Sulafat for the 8 cut-paper and 4 lot 2 shorts; see shorts[].voiced)
fieldNotes.coreTokens.motion.staggerSec: the identity's default stagger as written in its tokens.json; meaning varies (per-item stagger for most, spacing between beats/captions for atlas-grave 1.5 and liquid-chrome 1.55, title-to-body delay for neon-lab 0.8)
fieldNotes.coreTokens.motion.durationSec.slow: longest standard duration; for gazette-1900 it is one page (6 beats at 128 bpm)
fieldNotes.coreTokens.color.contrastOnBg: WCAG contrast ratio against bg, computed; muted/accent colours are often decorative (e.g. gazette-1900 muted = engraving fill, 1.07:1) and must not carry text
fieldNotes.renderCostSecPer100Frames: see renderCostNote: what is included differs per identity

rankingCriteria: durability/industrialisability: measured render cost 25%, templatability 25%, editorial breadth 20%, recognisability 15%, production risk 15% (out/report/comparison.md §5)
